title: MaleTheme Solo #014 · 남 맨즈 피지크·골드 글리터·복서 테마·메탈릭
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright coastal clifftop with a grassy path, a waist-high wooden safety rail, standard-height stone steps and a white lighthouse far behind him, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Samoan man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty-boy idol face with flawless smooth skin, large clear eyes, a slim jaw and soft full lips, clean-shaven, metallic gold glitter eyeshadow with defined lashes, smooth warm brown skin, a soft amused smile, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large platinum hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a gold barrel-shaped weight, a silver hammer head, a tin ship's anchor, an iron square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a silver barrel-shaped weight, a gold small flared temple bell, a gold round bell, a gold miniature anvil, a gold square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered gold hair ornaments. Extremely long square nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: An extraordinarily tall and large man, far beyond any real person, with a men's physique build. Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing glossy red boxing gloves and a minimal mirror-polished metallic red satin T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel and a thin gold-edged white waistband strap, on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his whole chest and stomach bare.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme red thigh-high stiletto boots with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
